purpose: Teach: カフカ/スマトラ/フィレンツェ/朝鮮日報/ヤコブ/パシフィック/トリビア/バッジ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカフカの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you a picture book about Kafka.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle cadence, like sharing something she noticed. Soft on the closing particle — inviting him to respond.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとスマトラの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a picture book about Sumatra with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush. Quick attack on the opening. Genuine excitement without performing it. Slight breathlessness — he can't wait to tell her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフィレンツェの絵葉書を下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave me the loveliest postcard from Florence.
lines.style: Soft appreciation in the voice. Slight pause before the destination — savoring the memory. Reflective, not performative. Trailing off gently at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと朝鮮日報の記事見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I saw an article in the Chosun Ilbo together!
lines.style: Proud, rapid delivery. Direct eye contact in the voice. He wants her to know he was there, that it mattered. Small and genuine laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヤコブの梯子の絵本読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you a picture book about Jacob's Ladder.
lines.style: Thoughtful opening. Slightly slower pace — as if she's considering the weight of what she's saying. Warm but not intrusive. Trailing particle hangs softly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとパシフィックリーグ観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took me to see a Pacific League game!
lines.style: Unbridled enthusiasm. Quick, bouncing energy. The pride of being included in something grown-up. No hesitation — just pure reportage of something good.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがトリビアな話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me the most interesting trivia.
lines.style: Soft smile in the voice. Appreciative, like she's sharing something delightful she learned. Conversational, intimate. No rush — she's just enjoying the recollection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがピンバッジを下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad gave me a pin badge!
lines.style: Peak excitement, slightly breathless. Direct, unfiltered joy. Bright attack on the statement. The voice lifts at the end — he's showing her, inviting her to see his treasure.
